avoid_supplements.name: Sildenafil (Viagra)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both cause vasodilation; concurrent use results in severe, uncontrolled hypotension and cardiovascular collapse
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication - patient must avoid all phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors

avoid_supplements.name: Tadalafil (Cialis)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent synergistic vasodilation causing severe hypotension; tadalafil has prolonged half-life increasing risk duration
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated - maintain minimum 48-hour separation; recommend alternative ED therapy

avoid_supplements.name: Riociguat
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator causes life-threatening hypotension when combined with nitrates
avoid_supplements.action: Absolute contraindication - do not combine under any circumstances

caution_supplements.name: L-arginine
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance nitrate-induced vasodilation and potentiate hypotensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; counsel patient on dizziness risk and report symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate vasodilatory effects and affect blood pressure regulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive hypotension; assess blood pressure at follow-up visits

avoid_foods.name: High-dose grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may theoretically increase nitrate levels and hypotensive effects
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid regular grapefruit juice consumption; occasional consumption likely safe

caution_foods.name: Licorice (high amounts)
caution_foods.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and potassium depletion, counteracting antihypertensive effects
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to limit licorice intake; monitor electrolytes if regular consumption

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium may increase fluid retention and reduce nitrate efficacy in angina management
caution_foods.action: Recommend standard heart-healthy low-sodium diet for cardiovascular benefit

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of nitrate tolerance with chronic use and counsel on nitrate-free intervals if applicable. Blood pressure monitoring is essential; educate patient on orthostatic hypotension symptoms and safe position changes. Absolute contraindication with phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors requires explicit patient counseling.
